title: Register a SIP endpoint and receive calls
alias: subscriber SIP credential + connect to its address
summary: A subscriber's SIP credential is a username and password any softphone registers with, created with one POST. A SWML connect to the subscriber's Fabric address is the document that rings it.
scenario: A shop that wants the workshop's desk phone on a SIP softphone, reached from the main number

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/fabric/resources/subscribers/{fabric_subscriber_id}/sip_endpoints: username, password required; caller_id, send_as, ciphers, codecs, encryption
schema.json ConnectDeviceSingle.to lists a Call Fabric Resource address
